description.value: De Dutch Pannekoek House is a BC breakfast and brunch institution founded in 1975, specializing in Dutch-style pannekoeks — large thin pancakes served sweet or savoury alongside eggs benedicts, omelettes, and hearty hash dishes. The Maple Ridge location is a licensed, full-service franchise restaurant situated in a strip mall on Lougheed Highway, a busy Fraser Valley corridor. It draws a loyal local following and offers a filling, calorie-rich menu well-suited to riders needing a substantial meal stop.

address.value: Unit 600-20395 Lougheed Highway, Maple Ridge, BC V2X 2P9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Maple Ridge location page confirms the address (Unit 600-20395 Lougheed Highway, V2X 2P9), supplies a direct phone number (604-459-1162) absent from OSM, and lists delivery via DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Skip the Dishes confirming takeout. Vegetarian options are evidenced by the menu (Mediterranean omelette with spinach/mushrooms/feta) and customer reviews mentioning a veggie pannekoek and veggie burger. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific infrastructure appears anywhere on the site.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: De Dutch is a legitimate, active food stop on a key cycling corridor, but none of the three WWC required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence; on-site verification is needed before a confident include decision.
